O.outcome_detail: oral reading fluency, measured as correct words per minute

cells.quote: LTTP II used a staggered entry cohort design, with randomization of school selection at the cluster level, allowing Cohort 2 to serve as a control group for Cohort 1 between baseline and midterm. Between baseline and midline, students in Cohort 1 improved from 4.8 to 14.2 correct words per minute on oral reading fluency, relative to almost no gains for Cohort 2 students, an effect size of 0.3 SD.
cells.note: The contrast is the Cohort 1 intervention period versus Cohort 2 before delayed entry; the study reports the intervention as a bundled program rather than isolating a single design feature.
